title: retry.sh rollup: keep only the latest run per workflow and event, and skip the whole commit when a failed run has used its retry budget
answers: Why does a Copilot PR stop getting CI retries after a few attempts?
Why are manual reruns counted toward the retry limit for a PR?
Where is the three-retry limit enforced for scheduled CI reruns?
body:
Path: .github/workflows/retry.sh (the paginated check-suite query, then the `suites` and `runs` jq steps) decides, for one head SHA, whether any failed workflow is still eligible for `gh run rerun --failed`.
Rule: Group workflow runs by [workflow resourcePath, event] and keep only the max by [createdAt, databaseId]. Then skip the whole commit if any run is not COMPLETED, or if any failed, timed-out, or startup-failed run has attempt null or (attempt - 1) >= MAX_RETRIES (default 3, set in retry.yml).
Constraints: The budget uses runAttempt, so manual reruns also consume it. Pages are combined with --slurp and deduplicated first; GraphQL errors or a missing commit fail the script closed rather than guessing.
applies: Scope: retry budget and pending-state logic in .github/workflows/retry.sh; not the per-PR search in retry.yml.
says: Pull requests stop getting automated retries once any workflow hits the maximum retry limit.
Manual test reruns triggered by developers are consuming the automated retry budget for pull requests.
The automated retry system skips our commit whenever another check is still running.
Explain why scheduled retries halt after three attempts on failed or timed out checks.
search: In .github/workflows/retry.sh, workflow runs are grouped by workflow resourcePath and event keeping only the latest by createdAt and databaseId, skipping the commit if any run is incomplete or exceeds MAX_RETRIES. Commits are skipped if any failed, timed-out, or startup-failed run has a null attempt or an attempt count meeting or exceeding MAX_RETRIES, defaulting to three in retry.yml. Because runAttempt is used, manual reruns consume the retry budget, and GraphQL pagination errors or missing commits fail closed.
